columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for a work pattern shift.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_SHIFT_CODE
columns.description: Unique code entered when creating a work pattern shift, in order to help user identify the work pattern shift.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the work pattern to which this shift pertains.

columns.name: DAY_INDEX
columns.description: Day of the work pattern to which this shift is associated.

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the shift from shifts library associated to the work pattern.

columns.name: START_TIME_OFFSET
columns.description: Offset from midnight. Defines the start time of the work pattern shift in minutes.

columns.name: END_TIME_OFFSET
columns.description: Offset from midnight. Defines the end time of the work pattern shift in minutes.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the shift in minutes.

columns.name: BREAK_DURATION
columns.description: Unpaid break duration of the shift.

columns.name: PAID_BREAK_DURATION
columns.description: Paid break duration of the shift.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
